budget_items.topic: Aro Farm property valuation and purchase cost (public comment by Carl (Ernie)Sund)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sund said the Town assesses the Aro Farm property at $1.1 million and that the Town would not want to spend $2.1 million to buy it.
budget_items.quote: the property is assessed by the town as being valued at $1.1 million dollars and we would not want to spend $2.1 million to purchase it.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Sund cited the Jones House, appraised at $250,000.00, which the Town sold for only $10,000.00.
budget_items.quote: despite being appraised at $250,000.00, the town sold it at only $10,000.00.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Warrant 2/19/13 W 45-13 was listed with a total of $16,370.41.

budget_items.topic: Quarterly water commissioners water usage billing
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A quarterly water commissioners water usage billing was listed in the amount of $4,540.74.
budget_items.quote: quarterly water commissioners water usage billing in the amount of $4,540.74

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Domigan said she was waiting on Senator Flanagan's office on whether bond money would be released; no figure given.
budget_items.quote: she was waiting to hear from senator flanagan's office on whether bond money would be released for the project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Monty Tech wants a Stabilization Fund to set money aside for capital items; no amount was given and nothing would be put in immediately.
budget_items.quote: monty tech wants to establish the fund so that they could set money aside to maintain capital items.

budget_items.topic: Annual Town Election date change cost savings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board of Registrars recommended moving the Annual Town Elections to April 30 partly for cost savings; no amount was given.
budget_items.quote: for cost saving reasons as well as convenience reasons.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager was to present the FY2014 budget at a Finance Committee hearing on February 28; no figure was given.
budget_items.quote: the town manager would be presenting the fy2014 budget at the finance committee hearing on thursday, february 28th.

budget_items.topic: Mixed Use Village District grant application to MRPC
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Planning Department/Board will submit a District Local Technical Assistance grant application to MRPC seeking funding for a downtown Mixed Use Village District Bylaw study; no amount was given.
budget_items.quote: will be submitting a district local technical assistance grant application to mrpc to look for funding
